{{Quote|No matter what the odds look like, if the enemy has chosen the battleground, he has more resources than we're aware of. It becomes imperative to choose a new battlefield, one the enemy can't have prepared. Don't mistake that for cowardice.|Anonymous Zsinj analyst|<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>}}
'''Zsinj's doctrine''' was a military tactic conceived by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] that stated if the enemy chooses the battlefield, they have more resources available to them than what meets the eye, and therefore the battlefield must be changed to one the enemy can't have prepared. Zsinj implemented this doctrine even in situations where he initially appeared to outnumber or outgun the enemy. Zsinj's doctrine caused the warlord to flee from [[Solo Fleet]] during the [[Battle of Vahaba]].<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command" />
